:::{#exr-slr-additive}
#### Outcome as mean plus deviation

Show that each outcome in a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian)
is its conditional mean plus its deviation (@def-slr-deviation):
$Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-slr-additive}

Start from the right-hand side:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mean_i + \cdev_i
&= \mean(x_i) + \cdev_i
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_i$)}\\
&= \mean(x_i) + \paren{Y_i - \mean(x_i)}
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_i$)}\\
&= Y_i
&& \text{(cancel $\mean(x_i)$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

So $Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i$.

:::
